status: post hoc, locally specified after primary results; not preregistered
mapping: frozen literal symbols, selected representatives; finite ranks; expected 182 of 200
score: arithmetic mean over all mapped pathway genes of log2(DESeq2 normalized count + 1); paired treated-minus-common-control within each differentiation block
observations: three bivariate block-level differences; genes and libraries are not replicates
likelihood: bivariate normal; fixed-df=4 bivariate Student-t likelihood sensitivity at baseline priors
prior_correlation: LKJ eta=2, same across all fits
priors: mu components independent Normal(0,effect_sd); marginal residual SDs HalfNormal(residual_sd); all scales in mean log2(normalized count+1) units

diagnostics.remedy: one rerun of failed fit: tune=4000, draws=8000, target_accept=.99; retain failed diagnostics

report: posterior means, medians, equal-tail 95% credible intervals and P(mu>0) for both observed-day contrasts
derived mu_day3-mu_day1 as treated-day comparison only
all nine prior combinations and Student-t sensitivity
correlation/SD uncertainty and all computational diagnostics
no_rope: no justified biological threshold in this expression-summary scale; no ROPE, Bayes factor, acceptance threshold or new primary significance label
independence: conditional exchangeable differentiation blocks within these two backgrounds; no independent-donor or population validation claim; dependence by background not separately estimable
stopping_rule: run declared fits, report all results; no favorable-prior selection or pathway expansion; add concise supplementary evidence if computationally valid, regardless of direction or informativeness
